## 1. Summary

Collect the Conventional Commits listed below into the next release. Source of truth: [the main branch](https://github.com/vymalo/another-agentic-platform/commits/main/) and the generated release notes.

## 2. Intent

Version the workspace and both charts, and publish a GitHub Release when this PR is merged. The tag then copies the tested operator and API images by digest to that version, signs them, publishes both charts, and publishes `aapctl`'s four signed binaries and its Homebrew formula (AD-070 and AD-071, `.github/workflows/release.yml`).

## 3. Scope

The changelog and the version files declared in release-please-config.json (`Cargo.toml`, `deploy/operator/Chart.yaml`, `deploy/operator-crds/Chart.yaml`) and `Cargo.lock`. The images, the charts and `aapctl`'s binaries are published separately, after the tag exists.

## 4. Verification

This PR is generated by release-please, and generating it verifies nothing. The generation evidence is in [the release-please workflow logs](https://github.com/vymalo/another-agentic-platform/actions/workflows/release-please.yml). Before merging, review this PR's required checks and the commits it collects. The tag's run is checked afterwards with an anonymous pull and `cosign verify`.

[Release-please workflow runs](https://github.com/vymalo/another-agentic-platform/actions/workflows/release-please.yml). The generated notes below link to the commits they collect.

## 6. Risk Assessment

Medium: merging publishes a release, whose images and charts are never overwritten. Before merging, check that `operator-image.yml` passed on main for the release commit.
